JUSTICE GOVERDHAN BARDHAR Order 18/11/2016 Heard the counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor and perused the case diary.

The petitioner has moved this anticipatory bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
Considering the fact that the allegation against the petitioner is for offences under Sections 420,
483, 272 IPC and the fact that as per FSL report, on examination, samples of Ghee were found unsafe under Sections 3(1)(zz)(iv)(v)(xi) of the Food Safety ( 2 of 2 ) [CRLMB-10349/2016] and Standard Act, 2006, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the present petitioner.
Consequently, the anticipatory bail application is dismissed.
(GOVERDHAN BARDHAR)J. ms/-16 Mangi Lal vs State on 18 November, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125981119/
